enchantorder.picker.title: Enchantments
enchantorder.button.my_books.tooltip: Tick every enchantment you have a book for in your inventory
enchantorder.order.title: Best order
enchantorder.order.empty: Tick the enchantments you want on the left, and the cheapest order to put them on shows up here.
enchantorder.order.too_expensive: There is no order where every step costs less than 40 levels. Try leaving out an enchantment.
enchantorder.tooltip.levels: Click the arrows to pick a different level
enchantorder.tooltip.too_many: You can plan up to %s books at once
enchantorder.auto.checkbox.tooltip: When this is ticked, an Apply button shows up below the steps. Click it and the mod combines the books and puts them on the item for you.
enchantorder.auto.apply.tooltip: Do every step for you. Costs %s levels.
enchantorder.auto.levels: You need %s levels to do this (you have %s)
enchantorder.auto.holding: Put down the item you're holding first
enchantorder.auto.closed: Stopped because the anvil closed. Open it again and click Apply to carry on.
enchantorder.auto.holding_stop: Stopped because something is on your cursor.
enchantorder.auto.no_result: Stopped: the anvil won't combine these.
enchantorder.auto.wrong_result: Stopped: the anvil made something other than planned.
enchantorder.auto.too_expensive: Stopped: this step is too expensive.
enchantorder.auto.not_enough: Stopped: the rest needs %s levels and you have %s.
enchantorder.auto.stuck: Stopped: the items won't move. Is your inventory full?
